origin_setup.first_word: actor+$002A is compared with $12B4; add $0030 when negative, otherwise $FFD0
origin_setup.normalizer: CODE_80:E19B returns X/Y stored in local $08/$0C

initialization.failure: either gate carry branches to CODE_80:D6AB with A=$0100
initialization.success: increments local $32, initializes $24/$28 to $FFFF, updates flags in $02 and $07A2, queues DATA_82:ED5D/ED63 and DATA_82:C5B6

limitations: Actor offsets, $12B4 comparison, and local $08/$0C are not assigned world-coordinate or collision-shape semantics here.
The two gates and CODE_80:D6AB outcome are not named as a particular gameplay event.
Queued tables are not treated as final graphics without matching runtime OAM/VRAM/CGRAM evidence.
